items.title: We Could Just Feed Everyone [We Can Have Nice Things, Actually: Episode 1]
items.description: Welcome to the first episode of our new podcast series "We CAN have nice things, actually" where we discuss solutions to the many problems the world is currently struggling with. Often you gain more from solving many small problems, than you do getting bogged down solving 1 bigger problem and ignoring everything else. This first episode focuses on food security and ways that we can make sure everyone is fed. It's actually easier than you'd think. From government programs and community fridges, to multicropping, milpas and chinampas. items.title: Can slime molds get stoned?
items.description: Want a pet Jerry of your own? Preorder yours today at: https://thethoughtemporium.ca/ Slime molds are some of the strangest creature on earth that often seem to break many of the rules of biology. And yet they also contain much of the same biochemical machinery that we do. So we wanted to see if the same chemicals that humans use for medicine have similar effects on slime mold. items.title: My Secret Editing Trick
items.description: For years I've edited many of my videos with help from my Dad. We get on a zoom call and I share my screen so he can see the edit as it goes and tell me if something looks wrong. I get better videos AND get to spend time with my Dad. It's win win.
